text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. While countless Umamusume
are giving and receiving chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, give me a break...
Is there anywhere to hide...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
Somewhere I can hide!
(Rattle-clatter-clatter)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My bad, thanks for the save.
Poking my head out of the classroom to peek outside---

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Pocket-senpai,
I'm pretty sure she was around here...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Where could they have gone...?
I wanted to thank them for helping me back in the summer.

...Apparently, Jungle Pocket was actively
avoiding chocolates from Air Messiah.
choice_data_list: You don't want to accept it?
You don't want to accept it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah, it's not that...
I just don't know what kind of face I should make while taking it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Acting happy or acting annoyed both feel kinda wrong to me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine giving stuff to my buddies,
but receiving things... I'm really not good at that.
...It seemed Jungle Pocket simply couldn't accept chocolates smoothly.
choice_data_list: Why not just accept it casually?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It ain't that easy. They're dead serious.
If you think it's so doable, partner, why don't you show me yourself?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll give ya some chocolate, so show me how it's done.
And so, I decided to accept the chocolate from Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I whipped it up real quick, but...
Whoa, wrapping it up made it look super fancy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, whatever. I'm handing it over casually,
so just accept it casually, got it?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Partner, this is, well...
How I feel... I guess."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I don't mean anything weird by it.
It's just a way of sayin' thanks, or settlin' things properly.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: So, uh...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll give it to you! Eat it! Take it!

The handoff wasn't exactly smooth...
but I casually accepted it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what's with this? I thought I'd be
fine handing it over, but this is actually pretty embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"You're just as bad. I handed that to you
dripping in sweat, and you took it without batting an eye."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Give it back.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"If you ain't happy with it, give it right back,
you jerk!"
choice_data_list: No, no, you already gave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Give it back, I say~!

Perhaps out of rage, Jungle Pocket chased after me with a red face.
As I frantically ran away...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hello, Pocket-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Messiah... H-Hey there...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um—is now a good time?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... It feels kind of good, but
also kind of not...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —There's something I want to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Y-You bastard... Just you remember this.

Cornered by Air Messiah's polite and courteous pressure,
Jungle Pocket was left completely flustered.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there! Wait,
isn't that Jungle Pocket!?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It really is! Eeeeek,
I'm so glad I brought chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, crap...
Did they spot me...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'm totally surrounded...! At this rate, I'm practically guaranteed to get chocolate-lynched, hey!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaah,
Jungle Pocket~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Stop it, sto—stay away~!
I barely managed to escape by a hair's breadth.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Good grief, I've shown you nothing but my uncool side today, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm wiped out... That felt worse than a race...
I'm totally beat.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I made some earlier.
Alright, let's eat.
Rustling the paper, I open the handmade chocolate Jungle Pocket gave me, and...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I did the best I could, y'know. I wanted
to make a cool spiked bat chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, looking closely, it's terrible.
It's pretty much just a bent chocolate steel pipe, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how embarrassing...!
Just watch, my real skills are way better than this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'm definitely gonna make chocolates
that'll shut you right up.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ah, let's destroy the evidence. Snap it in half. Then give me half. Let's just eat it.

The two of us crunched happily on the chocolate steel pipe.
Sharing both the sweetness and the bitterness in half.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There she is. Pocket-senpai.
With her Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's hold off for now.
We can try again another time.

I thought I sensed someone's presence for a moment...
but maybe it was just my imagination.
